title: Ἰλιακά: Antehomerica, Homerica, Posthomerica (Carmina Iliaca)
author: John Tzetzes
genre: Hexameter epitome of the Trojan War, with the author's scholia
edition: Leone 1995 (Catania); Jacobs 1793 and Bekker 1816 (public domain; URLs not checked).
ru_evidence: No Russian translation found. ru.wikipedia lists only 1969 excerpts of Tzetzes' works in general.
value: A Byzantine school epic and reception of the epic cycle. Preserves otherwise lost material, e.g. a Cassius Dio passage on Archimedes (Rance, CQ 2023). The scholia show classroom method. Pairs naturally with the Chiliades.
ai_feasibility: High. Straightforward hexameters; Tzetzes' own scholia guide the commentary.
